pages.text: Teleports an entity or item to a position.$(br2)This needs allowTeleporting or an administrator as owner. Only administrators can teleport players. Both raise PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise. An entity that is not loaded raises INVALID_ARGUMENT.
$(li)$(1)uuid$() STRING: the UUID of the entity$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: the destination
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/TELEPORT$(br)  PARAMETER uuid pigId ;$(br)  PARAMETER position barn ;$()
